name: hmi_compile
description: Compile a WinCC Unified HMI using ICompilable. The HMI is selected like in the other HMI tools: by exact software, device item or device name, or automatically when the project has only one HMI; several HMIs without target_name fail and list them. Returns state, errors, warnings, messages, and the compiled target and object.

target_name.description: Exact HMI software, device item, or device name, e.g. 'HMI_RT_1' or 'HMI_1'; optional when the project has exactly one HMI.

target_device.description: Deprecated alias of target_name, kept for existing clients. If both are given they must match.
